subject.title: fix: narrow execSchema.yieldMs from Type.Number to Type.Integer({minimum:0})

question: Should the shipped model-facing `exec.yieldMs` contract continue accepting all numbers that runtime normalizes, or intentionally become integer-only?
rationale: Current runtime behavior and Node's timer contract do not establish fractional values as erroneous, so rejecting them is a compatibility and product-policy choice rather than a demonstrated bug fix.

options.title: Keep numeric input
options.body: Preserve `Type.Number` and the existing runtime clamp because it already safely normalizes negative, fractional, and out-of-range values.

options.title: Adopt integer-only input
options.body: Approve the compatibility tightening, align the schema range with the runtime contract, and require live provider tool-call proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep numeric input
recommendation.body: Preserve `Type.Number` and the existing runtime clamp because it already safely normalizes negative, fractional, and out-of-range values.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shipped work on explicit `yieldMs` and background timeout behavior makes this person the strongest available owner for the permanent contract.
